title: Career Roadmap · Beautician
summary: A Beautician provides professional beauty and personal-care services such as skincare, makeup, hair styling, manicure, pedicure and client consultations, with opportunities in salons, spas or self-employment.

facts.Current degree: ITI Hair & Skin Care / Cosmetology / Beauty

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 is sufficient for entry to the DGT CTS Cosmetology trade.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: No specific Class 11–12 stream is generally required for this ITI route.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Skincare, hair care, makeup, nail care, hygiene and salon operations.

blocks.label: Build early
blocks.text: Communication, client service, safe product handling, hand skills and basic business knowledge.

rows.text: Hair and skincare foundation; check course-specific eligibility
Focused salon, skincare or makeup services
More advanced practical and service-management skills
Running a salon, budgeting and managing staff

blocks.text: DGT lists Cosmetology as a one-year CTS trade with Class 10 entry eligibility. Course availability and exact requirements should be confirmed with the current official notification.

blocks.label: Year 1 / Foundation
blocks.text: Hygiene, skin and hair basics, tools, client consultation and safety.

blocks.label: Year 2 / Advanced practice
blocks.text: Makeup, facials, hair styling, nail care and service-specific practice, if available in the chosen program.

blocks.label: Year 3 / Experience
blocks.text: Salon practice, supervised client service, product knowledge and portfolio building.

blocks.label: Year 4 / Career growth
blocks.text: Advanced specialization, business planning, salon management or further training as appropriate to the qualification.

blocks.label: Practice projects
blocks.text: Makeup portfolio • Skincare consultation checklist • Hair-styling portfolio • Sample salon menu with service costs.

blocks.label: Government / training
blocks.text: ITI workshops, recognized skill centres and approved practical-training programs.

blocks.label: Private
blocks.text: Salons, spas, bridal makeup studios, beauty academies, wellness centres and cosmetics retailers.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Client consultation • Makeup and hairstyling • Salon hygiene • Appointment and product-stock management.
Search for supervised trainee roles and verify the employer’s training conditions. Internship or placement availability is not guaranteed.

items: Advanced makeup, skincare, hair or nail training
blocks.label: Specialist route
Important
blocks.text: Medical dermatology, injectables and other clinical procedures are not routine beautician services; they require separate lawful qualifications and authorization.
Relevant programs

blocks.label: Indian institutions
blocks.text: DGT-affiliated ITIs, relevant NSTIs, recognized Skill India training providers and established beauty academies. Confirm the exact course, recognition and practical hours before enrolling.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Beauty salons, spas, bridal services, hospitality, cosmetics retail, wellness centres and freelance services.
Technical skills

items.text: Skin and hair assessment within non-medical scope
Manicure, pedicure and basic nail care

blocks.text: Tools / technologies

items.text: Hair dryers, straighteners and styling tools
Sterilization / sanitation equipment appropriate to the service
Digital booking, customer records and payment tools

blocks.text: Useful credentials

items.text: Recognized Beauty & Wellness qualification, where available.
Advanced makeup or hair-styling certification from a reputable provider.
Salon hygiene, client service and small-business training.

blocks.text: Choose training with supervised practical assessments rather than relying on certificates alone.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand and Germany.
Institutions / training routes to investigate

blocks.label: UK
blocks.text: Further-education colleges offering beauty therapy qualifications.

blocks.label: Australia

blocks.label: Canada

blocks.text: Recognized vocational pathways in cosmetics and personal care.
Common admission requirements

items.text: Previous schooling as specified by the institution.
English or local-language proficiency where required.
Practical assessments or portfolio, where applicable.
Proof of funds and visa documents where applicable.

blocks.text: Course names, recognition, licensing and admission requirements differ by country. Verify each institution’s official course page before applying.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Beauty Therapist, Makeup Artist, Nail Technician, Hair Stylist and Salon Assistant.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Beauty salons, spas, hotels, bridal services and personal-care businesses.
